gloss: selfish; self-indulgent; doing as one pleases

definitions.gloss: selfish; self-indulgent; doing as one pleases without regard for others
definitions.explanation: Describes behavior or a personality that follows personal desires and whims without consideration for others. Carries a negative connotation of willfulness and selfishness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{勝手|かって}{気|き}まま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{暮|く}らしている→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
{勝手|かって}{気|き}ままな⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷惑|めいわく}→迷惑：02432_meiwaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: Selfish behavior causes trouble for those around you.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{勝手|かって}{気|き}ままだった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: He was self-indulgent as a child, but changed after entering the workforce.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{勝手|かって}→勝手：03021_katte⟧ (selfishness; doing as one likes) and ⟦{気|き}まま→気まま：10311_kimama⟧ (whimsical; carefree). Together they reinforce each other to describe someone who acts entirely on personal whims without considering the impact on others. The tone is distinctly negative when describing someone's character, though it can sound envious when describing a lifestyle.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {勝手|かって}{気|き}まま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧: to live as one pleases
- {勝手|かって}{気|き}ままな⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}い→振る舞い：10520_furumai⟧: self-indulgent behavior
- {勝手|かって}{気|き}ままな⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: selfish personality

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{気|き}まま→気まま：10311_kimama⟧: carefree; whimsical — lighter in tone, can be positive (enjoying freedom)
- ⟦{勝手|かって}→勝手：03021_katte⟧: selfish; arbitrary — focuses on acting without permission or consideration
- ⟦{自分勝手|じぶんかって}→自分勝手：19490_jibunkatte⟧: selfish; self-centered — emphasizes putting oneself first
- ⟦わがまま→わがまま：03789_wagamama⟧: selfish; spoiled — the most common everyday word for selfishness
